messages:
anya: Quick design sync / streaming playground UI. Noticed when the stream is fast the stop button briefly covers trailing tokens. Can we avoid overlap?

leo: Yeah, the overlap looks glitchy. Two ideas: reserve space for the toolbar always, or make the toolbar overlay but with a subtle gradient fade so tokens remain legible.

devon: I prefer reserving space to prevent layout shift. Users get distracted when things jump. We can compress the toolbar height during stream and expand after.

anya: Compression might work. Also copy thought: change small-screen icon tooltip from "Stop" to "Stop generation" for clarity. Icon-only buttons need persistent aria-labels.

uxbot: Accessibility reminder: maintain consistent aria-labels across visual state changes. Use aria-live region for status updates (e.g., "Generation paused", "Generation complete"). Ensure focus order keeps Stop reachable first.

sara: Token counter proposition: show a muted inline pill with shorthand count (e.g., "34 tok"), expand to full label on hover/focus. Keeps layout steady and readable.

leo: Good. Add reduced font-weight while streaming so the response text remains dominant. Also respect prefers-reduced-motion for the toolbar animate.

devon: On timing, the handoff transition felt abrupt in last dev build. Suggest 180ms fade for toolbar and 60ms stagger for the token pill so they don't compete visually.

anya: Prompt library placement: current mock uses right-side shelf. For narrow viewports the shelf obscures controls. Could we collapse into a slide-over that pushes content on desktop and becomes a bottom sheet on mobile?

sara: Slide-over push on desktop is safest for discoverability. Bottom sheet on mobile with accessible close control and focus trap that returns to the invoking button on close. Announce "Prompt library opened".

leo: I'll prototype the compressed toolbar + reserved space and token pill. Devon, can you add the 180ms/60ms timing to the prototype? Sara, please write the a11y checklist items into the ticket.

uxbot: Created ticket PL-4980: "Playground stream: toolbar reserve, token pill, prompt library responsive UX + a11y". Checklist added.

anya: Thanks everyone. Post prototype link here when ready.

leo: Will share by EOD with small/large screenshots.
